notes: NCD compare is now on the toolbar, next to Backup. Ignition on / off: when the car wants it, press Disconnect in E-Sys and choose it again, E-Sys MAX then switches it itself. Keys tab: a typed value is set even when the module's list does not show it (99 = hex 63), and the tree on the left jumps to the setting after Enter. Error messages now say in plain words what went wrong and what to do.
